title:
Comment of Anita Barrett in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/28/2026

documents.name: 151898.txt
documents.text:
Anita Barrett, W Palm Bch, FL.
I am against this data center. Stop selling off our public lands. This data center will harm endangered whales. 

Time to stop corporate greed. The beluga whales already have too much to contend with. Majority of citizens wish NOT to have data centers. 

I visited this area a few years ago. This is an awful place for human development. Please allow nature to return to normal and stop datacenter development.
